title: hydrangea macrophylla f. rosea
intro: Hydrangea macrophylla f. rosea, commonly known as the pink hydrangea, is a flowering plant species within the hydrangea genus. This plant is known for its large, showy pink flowers and is often used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Hydrangea macrophylla f. rosea include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing pain, inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
